rule: FinOps IQ platform playbook (WS-S3; PLAN F8; IMPROVEMENT_PLAN 5.1). Controls are FIN.<CAPABILITY> for capability gap findings and FIN.<LEVER> for levers (e.g. FIN.ALLOCATION, FIN.LEV-01). The approach comes first, then options per platform, named as the provider names them, with alternatives; options are validated per engagement against current availability, pricing and licensing. Every control in technicalControls has an entry, or an explicit noPlatformAction entry, for every platform; other controls may use platform 'any' for practice-level actions. Each entry cites claims in the claims register and is reviewed by its nextReview date.
